Both proclamations commemorate a state's centennial, identify the date and ordinal position of its admission to the Union, mention the state's sobriquet, cite a joint resolution authorizing a presidential call for commemoration, and use nearly identical operative language calling upon the American people to observe the one-hundredth anniversary with appropriate ceremonies. C15 has related centennial observance language, while C07 concerns a statehood anniversary but primarily uses invitation-to-exposition machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas on May position."},{"child_excerpt":"Whereas the centenary of this richly endowed Commonwealth, celebrated as the \"Star of the North\", will be commemorated with appropriate Union","explanation":"The same legislative authorization is recited in closely corresponding language."},{"child_excerpt":"pursuant to the joint resolution of Congress, do hereby call upon the
